heading: Integrations
intro: What this deployment is really connected to. Checked when the page loads.
aiSimulated: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set. Intake and rule proposals use clearly labelled keyword rules instead, and drafts use templates.
aiLive: The last AI call worked ({{when}}). Model: {{model}}. Used for message extraction, drafting and rule proposals. It never decides the colour.
aiFailed: The last AI call failed ({{when}}): {{summary}} The simulated mode was used instead.
aiKeySet: A key is set on the server (model {{model}}), but no AI call has been made yet. Try the AI intake to confirm it works.
databaseError: The server could not read the database: {{message}}
databaseLive: All records are read and written by the Next.js server using the secret key. The browser never connects to Supabase.
authLive: Passwords are checked by Supabase Auth from the server. Roles come from the app_users table.
bookingDetail: Bookings come from fictional demonstration rows in Supabase, shown in the Knowledge Hub. No real booking system is changed.
paymentDetail: Payments are fictional demonstration rows. Tutor Compass never processes or refunds payments.
calendarDetail: Availability slots are fictional demonstration rows.
emailDetail: Drafts are prepared for a person to copy and send. Nothing is sent by the app.
